title: Composing Independently Distilled Memory and Retrieval Policies for Long-Term Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.30230v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-lived Web assistants require effective memory and retrieval mechanisms to access information from past user interactions. While these capabilities can be learned through specialized policies, it remains unclear whether specialists trained independently in different environments can be effectively composed without joint optimization. This paper investigates compositional transfer through policy distillation. Memory-writing and sequential retrieval policies are independently distilled from frontier-model action trajectories into 3B models and combined with a fixed answer generator without downstream training. On a LongMemEval-based benchmark, the distilled composition achieves 73.1% accuracy, compared with 36.2% for a composition of existing RL-trained specialists, and also outperforms the evaluated RL-trained compositions on PersonaMem-v2. Component ablations reveal that improvements in individual policies depend on their composition

translated_title: 面向长期智能体的独立蒸馏记忆与检索策略组合
translated_abstract: 长寿命的网络助手需要有效的记忆和检索机制来访问过去用户交互中的信息。虽然这些能力可以通过专门的策略学习获得，但目前尚不清楚在不同环境中独立训练的专家策略能否在不进行联合优化的情况下被有效组合。本文研究了通过策略蒸馏实现组合迁移的方法。记忆写入策略和顺序检索策略分别从前沿模型的动作轨迹中独立蒸馏到3B参数模型中，并与固定的答案生成器相结合，无需任何下游训练。在基于LongMemEval的基准测试中，蒸馏组合达到了73.1%的准确率，而现有强化学习训练专家策略的组合仅为36.2%，同时在PersonaMem-v2数据集上也优于所评估的强化学习训练组合。组件消融实验表明，单个策略的性能改进依赖于它们的组合方式。
tldr: 该论文提出通过策略蒸馏将记忆写入和顺序检索策略从前沿模型独立蒸馏到3B小模型中并直接组合使用，证明了无需联合优化即可实现有效的策略组合迁移，其性能（73.1%）大幅超越现有强化学习训练专家策略的组合（36.2%）。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that memory-writing and sequential retrieval policies independently distilled from frontier-model trajectories can be effectively composed without joint optimization, achieving 73.1% accuracy and significantly outperforming existing RL-trained specialist compositions (36.2%).
